description: Automated evaluation set for Local RAG Assistant. Each in_scope case names the document its answer must come from and a few keywords a correct answer should contain (used as a lightweight, no-LLM-judge correctness proxy). out_of_scope cases have no matching document and the assistant should refuse (guardrail should fire) rather than guess.
